name: documented-skill-contract
description: Compares schema DEFINITIONS (the declarative SiteSchemaDefinition shape) against each other, or a schema definition against a live SchemaExport ("what would change if this target definition were applied against this current state"). Read-only -- consumes local files/objects only, never contacts a tenant, never writes an apply plan.
prompt: Use the diff-sharepoint-schema skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
